target.role: Associate Director, Model Innovation and Implementation

summary: Associate Director, Model Innovation and Implementation candidate with ~7 years across the development, implementation, and validation of risk models for institutional portfolios. Delegated sign-off authority at Moody's Analytics on valuation, sensitivity, and market risk outputs ($5–25bn per engagement); built an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine and production Python pipelines; agentic AI (LLM) development workflows in daily use. Monte Carlo scenario modelling and VaR/CVaR optimization at Ortec Finance. CFA charterholder; dual MSc.

sections.heading: Model Development & Implementation
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across portfolio horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed exposure and liquidity analytics (T+1 through multi-year) supporting hedging, funding, and asset-allocation analysis.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging and validation controls — deployed in production across the modelling team.

sections.heading: Market Risk Methodology & Model Validation
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and market risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement, cumulatively covering ~$50bn of client assets.

Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation — review curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release; escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility.
Oversaw interest-rate and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, aligned with IRRBB standards analogous to OSFI B-12 and Basel Committee frameworks.

sections.heading: AI Innovation & Model Governance
bullets: Built agentic AI development workflows leveraging LLMs (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) — automating code generation, validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation; reduced development cycle time ~30–40% on comparable modules.
Member of the model governance committee — methodology review and challenge, documentation and benchmarking standards, and assessment of model performance for client-delivered analytics.
Led onboarding and implementation of the PFaroe DB and PFaroe PM vendor risk platforms for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms.

Drove the migration and integration of all assigned client accounts from a legacy Calypso environment to the PFaroe PM platform — scoped requirements with investment teams, defined business logic, and validated model implementations post-deployment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients — aligned liability measurement and reporting frameworks with system implementation, model controls, and governance documentation.

Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators (Monte Carlo) assessing interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk under base and stressed environments; performed hedging analysis across rates, inflation, and FX.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization based on VaR and CVaR on Ortec's GLASS platform; conducted risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk, and near-optimal frontier robustness analysis.

Delivered ALM and portfolio analytics studies for Canadian and international pension funds — modelled actuarial liabilities alongside all major investment-product types under stress and sensitivity testing.

Presented quantitative findings to investment committees at pension-fund clients; led onboarding and the ALM study for the University Pension Plan (UPP) three-plan merger, developing and validating the model evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
